title: "GitHub Issues Round 2"
---

::: panel-tabset
## Task

1.  Address the issues currently on your GitHub and close them.

2.  You need to find a chart from two different students and leave an issue in their repository.

3.  Later, after the class has had a chance to leave some issues for you, address the issues your classmates left for you while they completed the previous bullet. In addition pushing updated charts to your repo, be sure you put a comment or explanation as a reply to original issue that was left to explain how you addressed it. Then close the issues

### Submit

In I-learn, submit a link to your GitHub Issues page showing that all issues are closed.
:::
